dedupe_keys.name: meteor tanzania flood hazard map fluvial defended for return periods of 1 in 5 10 20 50 75 100 200 250 500 and 1000 years

description: SSBN Ltd (Fathom) publishes defended river-flood depth maps for Tanzania in the METEOR project. Zenodo provides ten ODbL 1.0 GeoTIFF layers at stated 3-arcsecond WGS84 resolution for return periods of 5, 10, 20, 50, 75, 100, 200, 250, 500 and 1000 years. The description identifies maximum modelled water depths in metres from a two-dimensional shallow-water framework using MERIT terrain and hydrography. These layers can support regional exposure tests for roads, utility sites and public facilities under a defended-flood assumption. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Tanzania map set. A limitation is that the page does not identify individual defences, their design standards, condition or failure probabilities. A defended scenario therefore cannot establish real protection at a particular site. The provider cautions against detailed local engineering use, and each return-period raster should be interpreted separately. No raster or flood-defence geometry was downloaded or checked.
